verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs say its 100+ models span text, vision, audio and image on the same platform and API key. Vision is the best-evidenced modality: a dedicated 'Vision Models' entry, vision listed among recommended use cases, and vision-specific prompt-cache pricing. Audio and image generation appear only as one-line list mentions, with no endpoint or usage docs in the pack, so the story is not fully covered. Missing for 10: documented audio (speech-to-text/TTS) endpoints and usage, documented image-generation endpoints and parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of any non-text modality.
